## Issue and Lighthouse task

Closes #<issue-number> (use `Refs` instead for partial work).

Lighthouse task: T<id>. Link the current plan/spec sections and record the exact issue branch.

## Change and demonstration

Describe the resulting behavior and the smallest useful demonstration. Explain required reuse and any integration/migration changes.

## Completion prerequisites

List integrated dependencies and remaining gates. Do not claim completion from test adapters alone.

## Verification

Record actual commands/results and CI links, or clearly identify checks not run and why. No live AI calls in ordinary CI.

## Independent technical review

Link the fresh-context assessment with fixed base/head identities and separate bugs, security and requirements coverage. List blocking/advisory findings and dispositions. Record correction round 0, 1 or 2; explain any affected review refresh after fixes, rebase or integration changes.

## Limitations and owner decision

Identify material risks, unresolved questions and readiness limits. The owner approves and merges manually; an agent clear assessment is not merge authority.
